overall_rationale: All must needs (N1, N2, N3) are reachable only with conditions. N1 production is served by the internal station table and N1 prototype only by the UCI benchmark (single site, research-only licence to be cleared by Legal). N2 production is served by the traffic counts, which need an adjustment at the 2024-03-18 counter change and a counter-to-station mapping. N3 has the modelled Open-Meteo series for both windows (needs Legal sign-off and a Valdena location), with ARPA Lombardia and UCI as prototype benchmarks. N4 (should) is served by the aggregate clinic table with access and definition conditions. N5 is unmet because the policy permits only aggregates. N6 is partially met as national annual context. The Chicago link is not feasible (host refused, licence unknown).
